scripts.dev: npm run codegen:check && npm run build:wasm && vite
scripts.build: npm run codegen:check && npm run build:wasm && vue-tsc -b && vite build
scripts.build:e2e: npm run codegen:check && npm run build:wasm && vue-tsc -b && vite build --base /
scripts.test: npm run codegen:check && node --test ../scripts/release-metadata.test.mjs && vitest run src tests
scripts.benchmark:spectrogram: npm run benchmark:spectrogram:typecheck && vite build --config benchmarks/spectrogram/vite.config.ts && playwright test --config benchmarks/spectrogram/playwright.config.ts
